DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
THIS DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (the“Agreement"), is made and entered into this
dayof
,2020, by andbetween the CITY OF CHEYENNE,
CHEYENNE, WYOMING, a municipal corporation duly organized under the laws of the State of
Wyoming, hereinafter referred to as the “City,”and BLUEFEDERAL CREDIT UNION, INC., a
Federal Credit Union, hereinafter referred to as the“Developer."
RECITALS
WHEREAS, the Developer has secured approvals with the City to redevelop the Cole
Shopping Center with certainreal property situated inthe County of Laramie, State of Wyoming,
(hereafter sometimes referred to as the “Property"), and legally described as follows, to wit:
Block 5 of Mountview Park Subdivision, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County,
Wyoming, otherwise commonly known as 400 Cole Shopping Center, Cheyenne,
Wyoming; and
WHEREAS, the Developer desires to develop the Property and has submitted to the City
plats, plans(including utility plans), reports andother documents required forthe approval of a plan
according to the City's development application submittal requirements master list (the
"Development Plan Documents"); and
WHEREAS, the City has approved the Development Plan Documents submitted by the
Developer, subject to compliance with approval requirements and conditions which, among other
things, involve the installation of and construction of utilities and other municipal improvements in
connection with the development of the Property; and
WHEREAS, specific conditions of approval are reflected in the Certificate of Review
("COR") for the Development of the Property dated October 2, 2019, attached hereto and
incorporated by this reference as Exhibit A.The CORwas issued pursuant to Section 2.2.3 of the
Unified Development Code. Developer has received approval of the Development Plan Documents
based on therevised site plan and building elevations submitted October 2,2019, and the revised
landscape plan submitted July 3, 2019, for the Property; and
WHEREAS, the Developer has made a substantial monetary investment into the
development of the Property which includes: the redevelopment of a blighted shopping center;
granting additional rights-of-waytothe City; positioning future structures; all that require parking
areas and site access points in specific locations to capitalize on future circulation patterns and create
a viable commercial centerwhich is herein referred to as“Development”"; and
WHEREAS, the City intends to make future operational and/or maintenance improvements
to the roundabout at the intersection of East Pershing Boulevard/Converse Avenue/East 19rh Street
which includes additional right-of-way along a portion northwest of the Development; and
1:
WHEREAS, the Developer intends to execute that certain Irrevocable Public Access
Easement (*Easement") to the City granting the City an easement for public sidewalks across a
portion of the Developer's property, asfully described in the Easement Agreement.A copy of the
Easement agreement is attached hereto and incorporated by this reference as Exhibit B; and
WHEREAS, the Developer intends todedicate aright-of-way along Converse Avenue and
East Pershing Boulevard (the “ROw") as shown and more fully described on the ROW dedication
attached hereto and incorporated by this reference as Exhibit C; and
WHEREAS, the Developer is granting the Easement and ROW as consideration for the
covenants contained within this Agreement; and
WHEREAS, serious damage and irreparable harm to Developer would occur if anyfuture
responsibility of regional improvements are placed upon the Developer, and points of access are
removed, relocated or downgraded.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the promises of the parties here to and other good
and valuable consideration, thereceipt and adequacy of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties
agree asfollows:
1.Recitals Incorporated. The foregoing recitals are incorporated herein by reference
into this Agreement as though set forth at length.
2.Terms. The Parties agree as follows:
A.The Developer shall construct the Property, abide by the terms of the COR
and the approved Development Plan Documents.
B.Upon the dedication of the ROw, the City shall not place future
responsibilities for any improvements on the Developer regarding operational or
maintenance enhancements to the roundabout adjacent to the Development at the
intersection of East Pershing Boulevard/Converse Avenue/East19"h Street.
C. The City shall not further remove, downgrade or restrict any access point(s)
beyond what is currently shown on the approved Development Plan Documents.
D.The Developer shall workwith the City in good faith to grant an expansion
of or an additional right-of-way at the intersection of East Pershing Boulevard/Converse
Avenue/East 19" Street, as may be necessary, subject to the limitations contained in
paragraph 2(c).Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Developer shall have no obligation to
related to the roundabout at the intersection of East Pershing Boulevard/Converse
Avenue/East19th Street.
